name: Center for Advancing Innovation and Standards for Super Intelligence (CAISSI)

statements.text: Establish voluntary agreements with private sector SI developers and evaluators, and lead unclassified evaluations of SI capabilities that may pose risks to national security. In conducting these evaluations, CAISSI will focus on demonstrable risks, such as cybersecurity, biosecurity, and chemical weapons.
statements.context: CAISSI mission page. Publication date unknown; retrieved November 7, 2026. These are model evaluations, not an assertion of embedded auditor access.
